description: Run one bounded, read-only diagnostic program on the selected Mac or a linked server. Arguments are passed directly, never through a shell, and time limits are applied. argv[0] must be one of: ping, ping6, dig, nslookup, host, traceroute, nc (with -z), curl (GET/HEAD), ifconfig, netstat, route, arp, ipconfig (get* only), networksetup (read-only queries), scutil, sysctl, df, uptime, vm_stat, uname, sw_vers, brew (list/info/services list), apachectl configtest, nginx -t, php (-v/-m/-i/--ini/-l), php-config; on Linux targets also nvme, iscsiadm, lsscsi, multipath -ll and InfiniBand status tools. ["oclp"] returns a macOS update-safety report for Macs using OpenCore Legacy Patcher. Anything else is refused by the Mac.

mac_id.description: Opaque id of one of this account's FrontierStack Macs. Optional only when exactly one Mac is online.

target.description: Optional linked server, by the name or host FrontierStack knows it by, to run on over SSH. Omit for the selected Mac itself.

name: diagnose
title: Run a read-only diagnostic
